profile.migration_strategy_justification: A hosted Yoke tenant gains or reuses the canonical Stage or Production environment that already identifies its running platform. The temporary compatibility bridge accepts only the same-org Platform-owned canonical runtime and never duplicates or transfers its site.

invariants: A tenant without a yoke project or active Yoke QA plan is unchanged.
The canonical hosted Yoke API site has one owner and is never duplicated or transferred.
A Yoke-owned site or the exact same-org Platform-owned canonical site has exactly one environment matching the Stage or Production runtime.
The compatibility bridge refuses arbitrary host projects, cross-org targets, noncanonical sites, and noncanonical environment ids.
Repeated apply preserves an existing compatible runtime environment.
attestation.residual_risk_notes: The migration refuses unknown runtimes, unauthorized site owners, cross-org targets, missing host-owned environments, and multiple runtime aliases instead of guessing. The narrow canonical bridge is temporary; WORKFLOW-TYPES closeout must replace it with explicit owner-authorized grants and revocation.
